back.target: since, as (giving a reason; a conjunction that sends the verb to the end)
back.example: Since it's raining, I'm staying at home.

note: In casual speech Germans usually say weil and use da mostly at the start of a sentence, so this sense is a bit more formal than the "there" card, but it is still common and correct; the hint's "as a reason" also rules out the time word seit.
